parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel made of plywood, forming one side support of the table.

parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel on the opposite side, made of plywood.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
